title: Synthesizing Public Opinions with LLMs: Role Creation, Impacts, and the Future to eDemorcacy

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating the alignment of LLM-generated policy opinions against real human responses from the Cooperative Election Study (CES) by prompting the models with specific political leanings (Conservative, Liberal, Populist) and HEXACO personality traits.

Measuring the overall adherence of synthetic LLM survey responses to actual human polling data to assess how accurately models can simulate diverse population subgroups and compensate for non-response bias in traditional surveys.
